diagnosis.summary: The nightly run for 2026-10-01 failed in dbt because dim_customers was edited to select c.country_iso. That column doesn't exist in stg_customers or raw.customers, where it is still `country`. Upstream data is fine, so I proposed reverting dim_customers to the deployed version.

root_cause.explanation: dim_customers differs from the deployed version by one line: c.country became c.country_iso. stg_customers and raw.customers expose only `country`, so dbt raised a Binder Error. The landing file matches the contract, and raw checks pass.

evidence.claim: dbt failed with a Binder Error: dim_customers references c.country_iso, which doesn't exist
dim_customers is the only changed model, and the only change is country -> country_iso
The landing customers file matches the contract and ingest config is default, so there is no upstream schema change
Raw partitions are present, row counts are normal, and orders reconcile to fct_orders

alternatives_considered: Upstream renamed country to country_iso: ruled out, the landing header still has `country`.
Add country_iso upstream or map it at ingest: unnecessary, since nothing delivers that column.
Request upstream redelivery: not a delivery problem.
Rerun only: the build would fail the same way.
Escalate to analytics_engineering: not needed, because a safe revert exists. The author may want to re-propose the country_iso change properly.

proposal.rationale: dim_customers was changed to select c.country_iso, which doesn't exist in stg_customers or raw.customers (contract column is country). Landing data is fine. Reverting the model restores the deployed version.

applied: reverted models/marts/dim_customers.sql to the deployed version
